title: Promoting Sulfur Redox Kinetics of Atomically Dispersed Fe-NC Electrocatalyst by Carbon Vacancy toward Robust Lithium-Sulfur Batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Accepted Manuscript

Jie Zhang, Dawei Yang, Canhuang Li, Qianhong Gong, Wei Bi, WEIHONG LAI, Shengjun Li, Yaojie Lei, Guangmin Zhou, Andreu Cabot, Guoxiu Wang
